decisions.rationale: Within the frozen 120-minute FT15 template, give the reusable S27/FT15 project brief an explicit step sequence in which each step that applies one of the three S27 concepts is preceded by just-in-time instruction for that concept (short embedded teach steps or the specific page sections, sized in minutes) inside the 70-minute Project block. Size the brief so FT15's Skim block plus Project block fit. Standard S27 learners, already taught, may skip the embedded steps. Do not claim the 58 page minutes as part of FT15. Keep one canonical brief and the frozen syllabus. Any FT12-FT15 day that still exceeds 120 required minutes stays a reported overflow for the Fast overlay (pep-t1-track-overlays), not hidden.
